title: Customers Bancorp, Inc. Hosts Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Webcast Friday, October 23, 2026
summary: Stay informed with the latest news, updates, and announcements from Customers Bank. Browse our press releases to gain insights into our growth, products, services, and innovative initiatives that shape our organization.
body_markdown:
WEST READING, Pa.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Customers Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: CUBI), the parent company of Customers Bank (collectively, “Customers”), will host a webcast at 9:00 AM EST on Friday, October 23, 2026, to report its earnings results for the three months ending September 30, 2026. The webcast will be conducted by Sam Sidhu, President & CEO of Customers Bancorp, and Mark McCollom, Chief Financial Officer of Customers Bancorp.


[Register online](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F218279058&esheet=54621029&newsitemid=20261013762922&lan=en-US&anchor=Register+online&index=1&md5=aef339501b3f7f1ddc3f16ce9f0b50f2) for the webcast. The live audio webcast, presentation slides and earnings press release will be made available at the[Customers Bank Investors webpage](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.customersbank.com%2Finvestor-relations%2F&esheet=54621029&newsitemid=20261013762922&lan=en-US&anchor=Customers+Bank+Investors+webpage&index=2&md5=096604d73d63e4a685b8baf55b37dc76) .


The third quarter 2026 earnings press release will be issued after the market closes on Thursday, October 22, 2026.


The webcast will be archived for viewing on the Customers Bank Investor webpage and available beginning approximately two hours after the conclusion of the live event.


**Institutional Background**


Customers Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE:CUBI) is one of the nation’s top-performing banking companies with approximately $27 billion in assets making it one of the 80 largest bank holding companies in the U.S. Customers Bank’s commercial and consumer clients benefit from a full suite of technology-enabled tailored product experiences delivered by best-in-class customer service distinguished by a Single Point of Contact approach. In addition to traditional lines such as C&I, commercial real estate, and residential and personal lending, Customers Bank also provides a number of national corporate banking services to clients in businesses including: fund finance, venture banking, healthcare, mortgage finance, and equipment finance.


Major accolades include:


- Named a Top Performing Bank by American Banker for six consecutive years (2021-2026), including the #1 spot in 2024 among midsize banks ($10B to $50B in assets)
- No. 45 out of the 100 largest publicly traded banks in 2026 Forbes Best Banks list
- Net Promoter Score of 81 compared to industry average of 41


A member of the Federal Reserve System with deposits insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, Customers Bank is an equal opportunity lender. Learn more:[https://www.customersbank.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.customersbank.com&esheet=54621029&newsitemid=20261013762922&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.customersbank.com&index=3&md5=72a1ecbb19a81f63299fb1569c5fa894) .
